conventions.bbox: [x0, y0, x1, y1], fractions of the PDF page (A4, incl. the white frame around the scan)

drawings.description: sous « $C_{\infty,3}$ », une longue flèche descendante aboutissant à une sphère : contour rond, équateur en ellipse (l'arc arrière interrompu), et trois gros points sur l'équateur, deux sur l'arc avant et un sur l'arc arrière.
drawings.kind: sphere with three marked points on its equator, reached by an arrow
drawings.notes: As on the page: the label C_{infinity,3}, the long arrow down to the top of the sphere, the round outline, the equator as an ellipse whose back arc is dashed (he broke it into three strokes), and three heavy points on the equator, two on the front arc and one on the back arc, each placed on the computed ellipse. A fourth, much smaller dot on the front arc between the two heavy points is drawn small (a pen rest or a fourth mark: see review). Nothing struck. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à gauche de « $\omega_1, \omega_2$, $\omega_2/\omega_1 = \tau$ », une sphère couverte de hachures obliques : contour rond, équateur en ellipse, trois gros points, un en haut et un en bas sur le contour, un sur l'arc avant de l'équateur.
drawings.kind: sphere covered with oblique hatching, three marked points
drawings.notes: The round outline, the equator as an ellipse, and three heavy points: one at the top and one at the bottom, on the outline, and one on the front arc of the equator. The oblique hatching, which he scribbled in one zigzag stroke across the whole sphere, is drawn as five separate oblique strokes: their number and ends are not his. Disagreement with the note of the transcription, which says « deux points marqués »: three are on the page. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.
drawings.disagreement: The note says « deux points marqués »; the page has three heavy points (top and bottom of the outline, and one on the front of the equator).

drawings.description: l'ellipse décrite dans le texte : deux croix à gauche, marquées $0$ et \uncertain{$2^{3}\cdot 3^{4}$}, un gros point à droite, deux marques épaisses en pointe de flèche sur le bord (en bas et en haut à droite) ; au-dessus un court trait horizontal, à gauche un trait vertical interrompu, à droite « $C_{1,1}$ ».
drawings.kind: ellipse with two crosses, a point and arrow marks on its rim
drawings.notes: The ellipse; inside, two small crosses at the left with their labels below them, 0 and the product read 2^3.3^4 by the transcription (uncertain there; kept), and a heavy point at the right; on the rim a heavy arrow mark at the bottom (pointing right) and a heavy tick at the upper right; above the ellipse a short horizontal stroke with a heavy end on each side; at the left a broken vertical stroke; at the right the label C_{1,1}. Still differs: the two rim marks are drawn as short heavy strokes with a head on the lower one; whether the upper one is an arrowhead is not clear. The transcription describes this figure in an editorial sentence of the text (« Une ellipse marquée de deux croix ... ») and had no mark for it. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à droite de « $D_n^{*} = \ldots$ », un pentagone découpé en secteurs depuis son centre : cinq sommets marqués (celui du haut d'un petit cercle, les autres de gros points), un gros point au centre, et une douzaine de rayons issus du centre, vers les sommets et vers les côtés, celui qui va au sommet de droite épaissi.
drawings.kind: pentagon cut into sectors from its centre
drawings.notes: The pentagon between its five vertices (top vertex ringed, the four others heavy points), the heavy centre, and twelve rays from the centre, all drawn from the one centre point: to the top vertex; to the upper right side; to the right vertex (heavy); to the right side; two to the lower right, ending on the right side and on the bottom side; one straight down, crossing the bottom side; one to the lower left stopping short of the side; two reaching the lower left side; one to the left stopping just short of the left vertex; one to the upper left stopping inside. Rays that reach a side end on it (computed). Still differs: several rays start a little away from the centre on the page and are slightly curved; the count of twelve is a reading (two faint strokes at the right could be one). Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: au-dessous, une ligne horizontale portant sept points marqués, prolongée à gauche par deux points et à droite par trois points de suspension (le cas $n = \infty$).
drawings.kind: pointed line continued by dots on both sides (n infinite)
drawings.notes: As on the page: a horizontal line with seven marked points (its two ends and five between, unevenly spaced, each computed on the line), two dots before it at the left and three after it at the right. A stray dot under the line, near the middle, is left out. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: au milieu de la page, deux arcs en chevron : celui de gauche terminé à gauche par une pointe de flèche, celui de droite portant une pointe de flèche vers la droite, chacun traversé d'une courte flèche transverse pointant vers le haut ; à droite, dans leur prolongement, un trait épais descendant portant un point ; au-dessous, quatre traits fins en éventail.
drawings.kind: two arcs with transverse arrows, a heavy stroke and a fan of thin strokes
drawings.notes: Two nearly straight arcs meeting (without touching) at the top: the left one ends at the left in an arrowhead, the right one carries an arrowhead pointing right near its right end; each is crossed by a short transverse arrow pointing upwards. At the right, continuing the right arc downwards, a heavy stroke with a point on it and a small hook at its lower end. Below, four thin strokes fanning downwards: three straight ones falling to the left and a longer curved one at the far right. Still differs: positions read off a wide crop (1 to 2 units); the heavy stroke is gone over several times on the page and is drawn once. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à droite, un cercle divisé : sept points marqués sur le bord, un diamètre montant vers la droite et prolongé au-delà du cercle, un rayon horizontal épaissi allant du centre au bord droit, une verticale tangente à droite ; un point isolé au-dessus ; à droite la mention « $\pm\frac{1}{n}$ » ; un petit zigzag sur le diamètre, en bas à gauche.
drawings.kind: divided circle with a heavy radius, marked +-1/n
drawings.notes: The circle with seven marked points on it (each put on the circle at the direction where he drew it), the diameter through the centre from the lower left point to the upper right point, produced beyond the circle at the upper right, the heavy horizontal radius from the centre to the point at the right, and the vertical line tangent to the circle at that side, from above the circle to below it; an isolated point above the circle; the label +-1/n at the right. Left out: a small zigzag scribbled over the lower left part of the diameter (hatching or a correction: not read). Still differs: his circle is not round, and the heavy radius ends slightly above the tangent point. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: au-dessous, un cercle dont six arcs sont épaissis, alternant avec des arcs fins, et à l'intérieur une flèche courbe de rotation, montant vers la droite.
drawings.kind: circle with alternating heavy arcs and a rotation arrow
drawings.notes: The circle, six heavy arcs on it (two at the top, one long and one short; two short ones at the right; one at the bottom right; one long at the left), separated by thin arcs, and inside the circle a curved arrow turning counter-clockwise, its head pointing up. Each heavy arc is drawn on the circle between the directions of its two ends as read on the page. Still differs: his outline is not a true circle; the two short heavy arcs at the right could be one arc with a gap; small ticks at the ends of some heavy arcs are not drawn. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: en bas de la page, une carte en forme de pentagone : cinq sommets cerclés reliés en cycle, une arête pendante issue de chacun (celle du haut finissant en fourche), un point cerclé au centre ; à droite, un astérisque.
drawings.kind: pentagonal map with ringed vertices and pendant edges; an asterisk
drawings.notes: The pentagon between its five ringed vertices (points with a ring round each; the left one larger), the five sides, one pendant edge from each vertex (to the left with an end point; down to the left; down to the right; up to the right with an end point; and at the top a short edge to a small vertex that forks into two prongs and sends another edge to the left, to an end point above the left vertex), and a ringed point in the middle of the face. At the right, apart, an asterisk of three strokes through one point. Left out: the frame of the boxed formula and its text, which run into the crop at the top right. Still differs: at the top, whether the forked vertex is joined to the top ringed vertex or stands just beside it, and whether the end point at the upper left is joined down to the left vertex by the short broken stroke seen there (drawn dashed), are readings. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à droite de « $2 = 2\cdot 1$ », un bouquet de trois cercles : trois boucles issues d'un même gros point, vers le haut à droite, vers la droite et vers le bas.
drawings.notes: As on the page: three loops from one heavy point, each drawn as a closed curve leaving and returning to that point: one to the upper right, one to the right, one downwards. Nothing struck. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: en haut à droite, un triangle hachuré de traits verticaux, de sommets $0$ (en bas à gauche), $\infty$ (en haut) et $1$ (à droite).
drawings.notes: As on the page: the triangle with heavy sides, its vertices labelled 0 (lower left), infinity (top) and 1 (right), and vertical hatching strokes, each drawn from a side to the base (computed on the sides). His strokes are seven or eight, unevenly spaced; seven are drawn. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à droite de la suite exacte, une carte de quadrilatères accolés, à l'encre sur un premier tracé au crayon, aux sommets numérotés $0$, $1$, $2$, $3$ ; deux faces du haut sont couvertes de traits croisés au crayon.
drawings.kind: map of quadrilaterals with vertices numbered 0, 1, 2, 3
drawings.notes: The ink edges only, each drawn between the vertices as read, with the digits beside the vertices where he wrote them. Upper row: the quadrilateral 1-2-1-0 (top side and right side heavy, the side 0-1 heavy, one diagonal in ink) and, to its right, the quadrilateral 2-3-0-1; pencil crossed strokes in these two faces (drawn as two pencil crosses). Left: the open polygon rising from the vertex 3 at the lower left to the stroke marked 3 at the top. Lower part: the edges from the central vertex 1 to the vertices 2, 0 and 3 below it, the edges 0-1 and 2-1 to the bottom vertex 1, the heavy edge 3-2 at the left, and the detached strokes at the far left and far right. Left out: the first pencil tracing under the ink (long curved strokes across the whole figure, and an arrow to the lower right). Still differs: this is a reading of a crowded figure; several joins are uncertain (whether the thin stroke from the vertex 0 goes down to the vertex 2 below it; the strokes round the lower left vertices 3, 2, 0), some digits are hard to tell (the 1 at the top vertex, the 1 at the bottom), and which faces he meant as hatched is not settled: the note of the transcription says « certaines faces hachurées ». Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à gauche, une sphère : contour rond, équateur en ellipse ; sur le contour, $i$ en haut, $-i$ en bas, un gros point à gauche et un point à droite, chacun avec un chiffre peu lisible (lus $3$ et $1$) ; un point marqué d'un chiffre (lu $2$) sur l'arc arrière de l'équateur ; près du centre, $0$ entouré d'une petite boucle ; un lacet descend de $i$ vers cette boucle, et une courbe va de $i$ à $-i$ en coupant l'arc avant de l'équateur en un point marqué.
drawings.kind: sphere with marked points i, -i, 0, 1, 2, 3 and loops
drawings.notes: The round outline; the equator as two arcs between the left and right points (front arc below, back arc above); the points i (top) and -i (bottom) on the outline, the heavy point at the left and the point at the right; the point on the back arc; 0 near the centre inside a small loop; the stroke coming down from i to that loop (the loop round 0, based at i); the curve from i to -i, which bends to the right and crosses the front arc at a marked point. The three digits beside the points other than 0 are small and hooked: read here 2 (back arc), 1 (right) and 3 (left, beside a blot), on the ground that the four marked points other than i and -i should be the punctures numbered 0, 1, 2, 3 like the generators lambda_0 ... lambda_3 written beside the figure; the left one is given by elimination. Disagreement in part with the note of the transcription, which reads 1 for the point of the back arc and gives no label at the left and right. Left out: the faint pencil ovals round 0 and a short tick on the curve. Still differs: the paths are free strokes, drawn as smooth curves through points read on the crop. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à droite, quatre figures de lacets dans le plan. En haut : deux points $i$ et $-i$ l'un au-dessus de l'autre, reliés par deux arcs en croissant, et chacun relié par un trait double à un gros point cerclé à droite ; une longue ligne fine horizontale traverse la figure. Au milieu à gauche : $i$ en haut, $-i$ en bas, $0$ entouré d'une boucle sur un axe horizontal gradué en $1$, un trait descendant de $i$ à la boucle, un trait double de la boucle à $-i$, et deux grands arcs de $i$ à $-i$ passant à droite de $0$. Au milieu à droite : un lacet en « V » à trait double finissant par un petit cercle, avec les lettres $0$ et $1$. En bas à droite : un lacet en équerre à trait double, entourant un point et finissant par un petit cercle.
drawings.kind: four figures of loops in the plane round 0 and 1, based at i and -i
drawings.notes: Four figures. (1) Top: the points i (top) and its mate below (-i, label not legible), two crescent arcs between them, a double stroke from each to the heavy ringed point at the right (a letter is scribbled inside it: not read), an arrowhead on the upper double stroke near i; the long thin horizontal line across the figure with a dot on it. (2) Middle left: i, -i, the loop round 0 on the horizontal axis, the tick and the label 1 on the axis, the stroke from i down to the loop, the double stroke from the loop down to -i, and the two large arcs from i to -i on the right of 0 (the inner one ends just above -i). (3) Middle right: a V of double strokes, from the top down to its tip and up to a small circle at the right, with the letters 0 (at the left) and 1 (inside the V). (4) Bottom right: an L of double strokes, coming down, turning round a point inside a small loop, and running right to a small circle. Left out: the faint pencil ovals round 0 in (2), two small dots near -i, the scribble inside the ringed point of (1). Still differs: double strokes are drawn as two parallel lines read on the crop, their closures at the ends are approximate; in (3) the letters are small and their reading (0, 1) is not sure. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.
